china-operators-p13-cd-report.summary: Revised restructuring report (signed September 2026) for the purchase of Chindata's China business (目标资产 秦淮数据); the same capture is already Atlas evidence for the Cunrui base and is reused here with identical metadata. PDF page 12 (printed 1-1-11) defines Sangyuan phases 1-3 as 环首都·桑园云计算产业基地建设项目（一期）-（三期）. The approvals table (PDF page 285, printed 1-1-284) lists Sangyuan phase 1 (河北秦淮数据有限公司; filing 怀发改备字[2019]60号; EIA approval 张行审立字[2019]565号) and Sangyuan phase 2 (怀来斯达智数据科技有限公司; 张行审立字[2023]118号; EIA approval 张行审字[2023]156号) as built (已建) with environmental acceptance completed (已验收); note 1 (PDF page 286) defines 已建 as projects that have obtained real-estate title certificates. The building-title annex (PDF pages 629-630) lists 冀(2021)怀来县不动产权第0012563号 for phase 1 (36,448.22 m2 of buildings on 33,333.33 m2) and four 2024 titles for phase 2 at 黄营村, Sangyuan town: the 1# power centre (第0005431号), the 2# and 3# machine-room buildings (第0005432号, 15,871.44 m2; 第0005458号, 15,836.29 m2) and the 4# pump room (第0005491号) on the 31,386.72 m2 parcel. The property section (PDF pages 257-259, printed 1-1-256 to 1-1-258) lists the 5# ancillary building and 6# switchgear building (901.72 m2) of the 110 kV substation used for Sangyuan phase 2 among buildings still without title and states that, as of the signing date, these buildings are in normal and sustainable use (处于正常可持续使用的状态). The construction-in-progress tables (PDF pages 504-505, printed 1-1-503 to 1-1-504) carry Sangyuan phase 2 at the end of 2024 (PDF page 505) but not at the end of 2025, and Sangyuan phase 3 at 28 February 2026 (PDF page 504). Together these support current operation of Sangyuan phases 1-2; the same table also marks phase 3 as built with environmental acceptance pending, which the valuer's reply contradicts, so phase 3 is not admitted. No phase-level IT capacity, customer or service-start date is taken from the filing.

equinix-emea-4-p14-eqx-q3-2026-earnings-.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 36, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - EMEA', lists by metro (columns Stabilized, Expansion, New, Acquisition, xScale, Owned, Leased; read by text position and checked against the column headers): Dusseldorf 1 IBX, DU1 Stabilized and Owned; Hamburg 1, HH1 Expansion and Owned; Munich 3, MU1 and MU3 Stabilized and Leased, MU4 Expansion and Owned; Frankfurt 11, with FR5 in the Expansion column and the Owned column; Manchester 4, MA1, MA3 and MA4 Stabilized and Leased, MA5 Expansion and Owned; London 10, LD3-LD8 Stabilized, LD9 and LD10 Expansion, LD11x and LD13x xScale, with LD4*, LD5*, LD6*, LD7* and LD8* Owned (* subject to long-term ground lease) and LD3, LD9, LD10, LD11x, LD13x Leased. The Status Change rows are empty and the EMEA change summary names only PA12x; the footnotes say atNorth joint-venture assets are excluded and that the stabilized/expansion/new categorisation is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025, and Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with an expected expansion of one or more additional phases (or a redevelopment), including data centers where a new phase opened on or after 1 January 2025. Slide 30 reports Q3 2026 cabinets billed and recurring revenues by category. The presentation thus states that DU1, HH1, MU1, MU3, FR5, MA5 and LD4 are operating Equinix IBX data centers (for HH1, FR5 and MA5, at least their first phase) in its portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. No address, capacity per IBX or opening date is given.

equinix-emea-5-p14-eqx-q3-2026-earnings-.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 36, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - EMEA', lists by metro the IBX data centers in the Stabilized, Expansion, New, Acquisition and xScale columns and whether each is Owned or Leased (* = subject to a long-term ground lease). Madrid: count 6; Stabilized MD1, MD2 and MD6; New MD5; xScale MD3x and MD4x; Owned MD2, MD3x, MD4x and MD5; Leased MD1 and MD6. Barcelona: count 2; Stabilized BA1; Expansion BA2; Owned BA2; Leased BA1. Warsaw: count 4; Stabilized WA1 and WA2; Expansion WA3; xScale WA4x; Owned WA3 and WA4x*; Leased WA1 and WA2. Its Status Change rows are empty and the EMEA change summary names only PA12x (Paris xScale); the footnotes say atNorth joint-venture assets are excluded and that the stabilized/expansion/new categorisation is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025 and Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with one or more further phases expected or a new phase or redevelopment opened on or after that date. The presentation thus states that MD1, BA2 (at least its first phase) and WA1 are operating Equinix IBX data centers in its portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. No address, capacity per IBX or opening date is given.

equinix-us-3-p14-eqx-q3-2026-earnings-pr.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 35, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - AMER', lists by metro the IBX data centers and their category and tenure. Rows used here: Chicago (6): Stabilized CH1, CH3, CH4 and CH7; Expansion CH2; New CH5; Owned CH3, CH5 and CH7; Leased CH1, CH2 and CH4. Washington DC/Ashburn (16): Stabilized DC1, DC3, DC4, DC5, DC6, DC10, DC11, DC12, DC13, DC14, DC15, DC21 and DC97; Expansion DC2 and DC16; New DC22; Owned DC1, DC2, DC4, DC5, DC6, DC11, DC12, DC13, DC14, DC15, DC16, DC21 and DC22; Leased DC3, DC10 and DC97. New York (10): Stabilized NY1, NY2, NY4, NY5, NY6, NY7, NY9 and NY13; Expansion NY11 and NY3; Owned NY2, NY3*, NY4*, NY5*, NY6* and NY11; Leased NY1, NY7, NY9 and NY13, where '*' is footnoted 'Subject to long-term ground lease'. Culpeper (4): Stabilized CU1, CU2 and CU3; Expansion CU4; all owned. The Americas change summary names only TR4 (Toronto) as a closed IBX, and a footnote says the Stabilized/Expansion/New categorization is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025, Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with an expected expansion of one or more additional phases (or a redevelopment, or a new phase opened on or after 1 January 2025), and New Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating on or after 1 January 2025. Slide 30 reports Q3 2026 cabinets billed and recurring revenues for the 193 stabilized, 52 expansion and 12 new IBX data centers. The presentation thus states that DC10, CH3, NY2, NY4, NY5 and NY11 (its operating phases) were operating Equinix IBX data centers at the quarter end, 30 September 2026. No address, capacity per IBX or opening date is given.
equinix-us-3-p14-eqx-q3-2026-earnings-pr.title: Equinix Q3 2026 earnings presentation (28 October 2026), slide 35 Data Center Portfolio Composition - AMER, slide 30 Adjusted NOI Composition and slide 47 Definitions

It says Microsoft is building the datacenter on the former Postalmarket industrial site in San Bovio. The old complex has been demolished and the area reclaimed. No start of works is reported.

rf-20-p12-ansi-datacenter-national-visit.summary: News item of Niger's national information-society agency (ANSI): its Director General, with close collaborators, made a technical visit to the construction site ('chantier') of the Datacenter National on Thursday 29 October 2026. Photographs uploaded with the item (/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/, two captured as local_data/country-research-rf-20-p12/ansi-dc-visit-11.jpeg and ansi-dc-visit-14.jpeg) show an unfinished interior with loose cabling and an exterior with open site works.
rf-20-p12-ansi-datacenter-national-visit.title: VISITE TECHNIQUE DU CHANTIER DU DATACENTER NATIONAL (ANSI Niger news, 30 October 2026)

rf-22-p12-atnorth-swe04-heat-reuse-20261.summary: atNorth's blog post of 4 November 2026, co-written by atNorth and its heat-recovery partner Calentix, is about 'the SWE04 data center in Sollefteå'. Under the heading 'Collaboration: From feasibility to development at SWE04' it says an early feasibility study with Calentix confirmed that heat recovery is technically feasible, including supplying heat to the nearby Långsele district heating network, and that atNorth and Calentix have now signed a Project Development Agreement: Calentix leads development of the potential heat-recovery solution and atNorth will provide access to the surplus heat from SWE04, together with site integration and infrastructure interfaces. The focus now is on technical design, site planning, commercial principles and agreements. The post describes SWE04 as a data-centre development at the planning stage; it reports no construction start, permit decision, completion or operation of the data centre.

locator.identity_review: The restructuring report places Sangyuan phase 1 (河北秦淮数据有限公司, 33,333.33 m2) and phase 2 (怀来斯达智数据科技有限公司, 31,386.72 m2) at 黄营村, Sangyuan town, Huailai. The Huailai planning publicities of 17 March 2023 and 14 March 2024 name the same phase 2 project, builder, village and 31,386.72 m2 of land, and the 2024 site plan, which gives the point, shows the titled 1# power centre, 2# and 3# machine-room buildings and 4# pump room, the substation's 5# and 6# buildings, and the phase 3 block on the east. The 2023 land-use analysis sheet places the built phase 1 land (一期建设用地(已建成)) south-east of phase 2 across the east-west road, west of S241, and the 12 May 2026 phase 3 planning verification gives the builder's address as the phase 1 base. The four printed corners reproduce the sheet's 104.70 m south-road dimension and a fifth printed point lies exactly on the west side; the approved phase 3 sheet's west red line passes within 0.01 m of the two eastern points, so both sheets share one grid. The sheet names no datum; read as CGCS2000, as the 2026 Huailai Jingxi sheet states for the same grid, the converted quadrilateral frames a large roof block in a 23 October 2026 Sentinel-2 L2A window, with the phase 3 block east of it and a further large block across the road to the south-east where the 2023 sheet places phase 1 (imagery used only as a check). This reopens the Sangyuan part of the q3-china-operators-p3 and cn-hebei-tianjin-beijing-p5 holds, which lacked a locator. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-11-07-china-operators-p13-chindata-sangyuan-geometry-facts.json.
locator.precision: Area centroid of the quadrilateral formed by the four corner control points printed on the official Sangyuan phase 2 site plan (14 March 2024) around the 2# and 3# machine-room buildings, converted from CGCS2000 3-degree Gauss-Kruger zone 39. The quadrilateral is about 105 m east-west by 172 m north-south (18,020 m2) inside the 31,386.72 m2 phase 2 parcel; the point falls on the machine-room roof block. It locates the Sangyuan campus through its phase 2 machine-room block, not a red-line parcel centroid, building corner, entrance, the 110 kV substation or a campus boundary. Phase 1, across the east-west road to the south-east, and the adjoining phase 3 to the east are not separately located.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The site plan names neither its datum nor the survey accuracy of its printed points; the CGCS2000 reading is supported by the 10 m Sentinel-2 check, and the conversion adds no material error. The point is a derived centroid of design control points whose corners lie up to 101 m away, and the phases 1-2 campus extends to phase 1's buildings roughly 150-460 m south-east of the point. Decimal places are computation precision, not accuracy.
